verdict.rationale: Finix's docs say it provides separate Sandbox and Live accounts, each with its own API credentials. Its test environment simulates live payments, including card payments, fee schemas and payout schedules. Together these cover the core of testing without touching production data. Missing for 10: detailed sandbox docs (test card numbers, data isolation guarantees, resetting sandbox data), sandbox access for AI agents or the MCP server, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
